notes: Open-scene compatibility only; no channel walls, no side grasp.
All variants share the same initial state, task, contract, skill library and evaluator.
legacy_0 and default are both target_quat=None; they differ only to confirm the new default path preserves legacy behaviour.
yaw_0 sets yaw_down(0) which equals the default downward grasp quat.
Positive compatibility does not prove channel success, path feasibility or a stable yaw-aware grasp.
Orientation residual is enforced by RebuiltSingleArm.move only when target_quat is not None.
